MathVerse: Solve visual mathematics problems in which essential information is contained in diagrams or figures, requiring perception, mathematical reasoning, and a grounded final answer.
MathVision: Solve challenging competition-style mathematical problems presented with visual content, combining diagram understanding with multi-step algebraic, geometric, or numerical reasoning.
MathVista: Answer visually grounded mathematical reasoning questions across scientific, diagrammatic, chart, puzzle, and everyday contexts using both image understanding and quantitative reasoning.
MMStar: Answer carefully curated multimodal multiple-choice questions that require genuine visual perception and reasoning while reducing dependence on text-only shortcuts and data leakage.
OCRBench: Read and reason over text embedded in natural scenes, documents, handwriting, charts, and other images, testing optical character recognition and text-centric visual understanding.
RealWorldQA: Answer questions about real-world images using object recognition, spatial and physical understanding, scene interpretation, and practical visual reasoning.
SEEDBenchv2Plus: Answer broad multimodal comprehension questions over images using fine-grained perception, object and spatial relations, commonsense inference, and visual reasoning.
